items.title: John Casimir Interview, 1959-01-17
items.q: Yeah, I played a bonquet with Wooden Joe.

ctx.x: Nothing special. Nothing special. I have to play the first hymn. That's when I'm a kind of more rag. With blues. Joe, and all that. Yeah. Dun, dun, dun, dun, dun, dun, dun, dun, dun, dun, dun. Anything you feel like. I've been playing him.

Now what about a bonquet? The bass bands ever played bonquet? Yeah, I played a bonquet with Wooden Joe. But you look like they don't have that anymore. Was that Wooden Joe's brass band or Dan's band? No, Dan's band played a bonquet. Oh, yeah.
